noAnchorGaps.concept: The reversal that follows the divergence
noAnchorGaps.quote: Real participation is fading, and a reversal follows.
noAnchorGaps.why: move cumulative_delta exposes only high1(pt) and top(pt) — no anchor for a post-divergence reversal point, so it cannot be drawn without inventing an anchor

notes: Only one CHART beat (divergence); the other three beats are CONCEPT (no chart). The divergence beat already labels both anchors the cumulative_delta move exposes: marker at high1 ('delta's higher peak') and marker at top ('price higher high, delta LOWER high — divergence'). These exactly capture the say's 'higher high at the top' vs 'delta line makes a lower high' divergence read — non-redundant, correct kind (marker on point anchors), sane labels/place. The auditor's proposal is upheld in full: no valid edits, and the 'a reversal follows' reference is a genuine noAnchorGap. I confirmed the move has no reversal anchor (high1, top only), so the auditor correctly declined to invent one.
